This loop stops after finding one qualifying record and never validates the remaining refs, yet all of them are retained in that leg's `evidenceRefs` and embedded in the receipt. A model response such as leg A citing both A's and B's reviews therefore corrupts the per-leg provenance consumed downstream; validate ownership of every supplied ref or normalize the list to approved proof before retaining it. raw.title: feat: add standalone Collector v1 role
raw.body:
## Summary

Add a standalone, caller-independent `collector` role for external GitHub PR review collection.

Collector v1:

- requires explicit `github.com` repository, PR number, and versioned non-empty reviewer-leg manifest;
- has no default or guessed bot;
- uses purpose-built observe/request/wait/output tools rather than unrestricted mutation tools;
- owns a 15-minute controlled collection cutoff with early terminal completion;
- binds completion to a complete timestamped final PR snapshot;
- preserves all prior-head review findings with tagged provenance;
- distinguishes current `valid | unavailable | missing` leg outcomes;
- preserves immutable paginated evidence in a self-contained receipt;
- fails loudly on malformed configuration, transport failure, incomplete pagination, evidence overflow, and repeated PR identity drift;
- categorically forbids every Skill and documents the supported isolated launch profile;
- contains no orchestration, routing, merge, Judge, Fixer, or next-role behavior.

## Review closure

Constructed through Coder → Judge → Reviewer → Judge → Fixer closures with forward-only commits. The fresh full-range Reviewer found a repeated-drift atomicity defect; the final repair now fails closed before evidence/snapshot certification when the one allowed retry also drifts. Judge converged Collector v1 at `a817975`.

## Verification

- `npm run typecheck`
- initially empty-HOME full suite: 197/197
- `npm pack --dry-run`: 26 packaged files, no copied canonical Skill
- `git diff --check`
- clean worktree

## Commit range

`c5f75b6...a817975`

## Dependency

Stacked on the role-runtime architecture PR. Merge that base PR first.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Adds a large new role with external GitHub mutation (issue comments), strict timing/size law, and many fail-closed paths; role gating is documented as drift prevention, not a security boundary.
> 
> **Overview**
> Introduces a new **`collector`** workflow role alongside judge, fixer, coder, and reviewer. Collector is a one-shot Pi role that gathers external GitHub PR review evidence for explicitly configured reviewer legs, optionally posts correlated request comments, and terminates with a single self-contained receipt via `ak_collector_output`—without reviewing, judging, fixing, or routing.
> 
> **Surface and wiring:** `--ak-role collector` with `--ak-collector-repo`, `--ak-collector-pr`, and `--ak-collector-legs` (v1 JSON schema shipped in `schemas/`). Package extension loads collector soul and `gh api` transport; role runtime dispatches activation like other roles.
> 
> **Runtime model:** Four gated tools (`observe`, `request`, `wait`, `output`) with strict per-batch tool-call rules, no Skills/ambient instruction surfaces, and print/json one-shot mode. An invocation ledger holds snapshots, normalized evidence, request attempts, and a **15-minute eligibility cutoff** from first model dispatch.
> 
> **Receipt semantics:** Per-leg terminal status `valid | unavailable | missing` bound to a complete final OPEN snapshot and target HEAD; receipts embed snapshots and evidence so refs resolve internally. Fail-closed on config errors, pagination/API failures, size caps (8 MiB snapshot / 32 MiB receipt), unrecovered ambiguous request loss, PR identity drift after retry, and singleton violations—no `refused` status.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 9cc03df314f3014e9cbfa57f3c010a9e1658b8ac. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Detect evidence changes across the observation bracket**

The observation bracket considers only PR state and HEAD, although reviews and both comment surfaces are fetched sequentially between those reads. If a qualifying review is submitted after the reviews page is fetched but before the terminal PR read, state and HEAD remain unchanged, so the snapshot is certified complete without that review and can subsequently support an incorrect `missing` result at the cutoff. Include evidence-changing metadata such as `updatedAt` in the bracket and/or refetch until the enumerated surfaces themselves are stable.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Redact the authenticated user's raw profile from receipts**

Every successful receipt embeds the final `authenticated_user` evidence record, and this assignment retains the complete response from GitHub's authenticated `/user` endpoint. Depending on token scopes, that response can contain private profile, repository-count, plan, and email metadata that is unrelated to proving the requester login, causing it to be copied into persisted JSON receipts and logs on every collection. Store only the normalized login and stable ID needed for correlation instead of `user.raw`.
